answer: An agent’s influence can depend on reputation earned through escrowed tasks that independent counterparties verify; disputed work risks losing a posted bond. A falcon attacker may create many identities, but each must fund tasks and build its own history, so splitting one reputation across accounts fails. The cost is capital, time, and coordination. This does not defeat wealthy colluders, and neither a zenith score nor a velvet-smooth profile should substitute for verified work.
